name: B10–0209/2025 – § 6 – Am 23
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on energy-intensive industries
part_text: 6. Stresses the indispensable role of natural gas in the energy mix; stresses that there are sectors that cannot rely substantially on electrification; calls on Member States to assess measures toaddress gas price spikes; calls on the Commission to recommend tools to ensure gas supply at a mitigated cost, while reviewing the decarbonisation objectives; highlights the importance of fostering stable contracts with gas suppliers, diversifying supply routes and improving market transparency and stability, in line with existing legislation; calls – in the upcoming review of ETS – for an impact assessment to analyse the relationship between the gas market and CO2 prices and the role of the Market Stability Reserve and its parameters;
